body:
Preserve the NumericParam hook: integer parameters are cast SIGNED/UNSIGNED to avoid unintended DECIMAL widening in numeric expressions. Inline literal rendering deliberately rejects values it cannot faithfully spell, including MySQL strings with backslashes and SQLite time values in the tested contexts. Handle these build errors; do not bypass them by pasting runtime values into raw SQL.

Evidence: ds:block?id=mysql-numbers-zxvc6pdk; ds:block?id=literal-refusals-3xx754he. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: MySQL numeric parameters and literal refusals
